notes.title: Version 1.2 Update
notes.content:
It's been a little while, but we're back with one more release, Version 1.2! It contains a new Survival Map, three new Quickplay Maps, some difficulty tweaks, and numerous fixes. Read on the full notes!

[hr][/hr]
General
Lines drawn with Ctrl-click now matches the player color. 


Campaign
Campaign Co-op added HP multiplier reduced from 25% to 20%. 


Survival
Added a new Co-op Survival map, Big Islands, that allows for an unlimited loadout, along with featuring Islands that have Generators and Aura Towers. 
Increased Survival progression points for clearing 5 waves from 5 to 6. 
Increased Survival progression points for killing a Boss from 6 to 10. 
Nerfed Big Islands difficulty quite a bit. 
Adjusted Two Sides so the first 30 waves are a bit more manageable. 
Adjusted HP scaling further to make more builds viable across all maps. 
Adjusted some of the more problematic waves in End Game Survival. 
You now gain ADDs slower on all maps in waves 60+. 


Quickplay
Added a new Beginner map, End Lines.  
Added a new Intermediate map called Outer Rim. 
Added a new Advanced map called Ultimatum. 

[hr][/hr]
Balance

Axons
Creator Boss spawns spawns per unit type reduced from 6 to 5, and spacing increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds(adjusted due to the HP multiplier fix) 
Advanced Repairer heal reduced from 100 to 75. 
Booster ability speed reduced from 280% to 270%. 
Disruptor base HP reduced from 160 to 150.
Linked Squdron healing cooldown increased from 1s to 1.5s.  
Marauder base HP reduced from 200 to 190. 
Medivac base HP reduced from 100 to 90. 
Replicant score increased from 1 to 2. 
Replicator and Carrier cooldown increased from 7.5s to 9s. 
Replicator and Carrier spawn limit reduced from 6 to 4. 
Reverser score increased from 12 to 20. 
Vanguard base HP reduced from 250 to 240. 


Defenses 

Artillery
U3 damage reduced from 13 to 12. 

Duplicator
Duration reduced from 14 to 13. U1 duration reduced from 18 to 17. 
U3 damage multiplier reduced from 225% to 200%. 

Energy Saw
Added another damage stage. 

EMP Gatling
Damage increased from 2 to 3. 
EMP duration applied per attack increased from 1.2s to 1.5s. 

EMP Mine
Cooldown reduced from 20s to 16s. 
Damage increased from 20 to 30. 
U2 damage increased from 40 to 50. 

Gravity Driver
U2 Slow reduced from 60% to 50%. 

Gravity Generator
Base slow increased from 35% to 40%. 
U1 EMP duration increased from 3s to 5s.

Network
Reduced cost from 125 to 110. 
Base damage reduced from 8 to 7. 
Reduced base damage cap from 20 to 15. 
Reduced U2 Slow from 3% to 2% per upgrade. 

Plasmathrower
Increased cooldown from 2 to 3 seconds. 
Increased damage of U2 and U3 from 15 to 16. 
U1 reworked: 
 -- Old: Range increased by 1. 
 -- New: Cooldown reduced by 1. 
 -- Damage increased from 16 to 18. 

Target Marker
Damage multiplier increased from 25% to 30%. 
Damage cap for the base trap and U1 reduced from 1500 to 600. 
U1 Slow reduced from 40% to 30%. 
Removed the damage cap from U2 and U3.

Overloads
Nuke AoE increased from 3 to 3.5. 
EMP Blast Duration increased from 7s to 8s. 

[hr][/hr]
Fixes
Fixed an issue where Chain Overload applied to Blockers.
Fixed an issue where Axons could cross removed Architect bridges due to Temporal Mine.
Fixed an issue where the Creator Boss' spawned Axons didn't take the current HP multiplier into account.
Fixed an issue where the "The Collector" achievement wasn't working at all. 
Fixed an issue where you could receive an upgrade for a Defense you just removed in wave 30 of Survival. 
Fixed an issue where Axon warning messages were popping up in replays. 
Fixed an issue with Omega spawning beacons on invalid platforms on specific maps. 
Fixed an issue where you could place down more ADDs than you had with fast inputs in Multiplayer, resulting in a negative amount. 
Fixed an issue where you were given the wrong Overloads after loading a Co-op save. 
Fixed potential causes of desync with Discharge Blaster and Seeker Drone. 

[hr][/hr]
New Project
With the release of Version 1.2, new content and feature development ends on Axon TD: Uprising. We are eternally grateful for all the support you've given us! 

As for Element Studios, we're now heads down on a new project. It will be some time before we can share any information on it. We're excited to share more when we're ready!

notes.title: Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
At long last, Version 1.1 has arrived! Its major features include PvP Mode, Skins, & Stats Profile. And as per usual, it comes with a bevy of balance, fixes, and other updates. Check out our video overview for the quick rundown, and below is our full notes!

[previewyoutube=S9IiiuS4Ydg;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
General
Added PvP Mode!
Is played in 1v1. 
You start with 30 lives and 3 pre-selected Defenses and see who can survive the longest, or who has the most lives left when the game ends. 
You can also play it with the same random loadout, or a completely random loadout for both of you. 
You can send Axons at your opponent. This costs Credits. The quality of Axons you can send increases as you send more.  
If your sent Axons are killed, your Credits are refunded during the wave. If they leak on the opposing side, those Credits are lost. 
If you leak, you get free spawns. These do not contribute to upgrading your Axons. 
This mode features 4 different maps and has 4 wave lists that it randomizes between. 
Various Defenses have had their base costs adjusted for this mode to be more viable. 
 -- Note: You can play this mode solo by starting a lobby with only one player. The opposing player will be replaced by a bot.

Added 3 Skins for each Defense. You unlock them by completing achievements. 
Added a Profile page! This can be accessed from the top-right corner in any menu (click your name or portrait). You can view your stats, achievements, and equip tower skins from here.
Added the ability to draw lines on the grid by holding down Ctrl + Left-click. 

[hr][/hr]
Balance

EMP Rework
EMP no longer completely shuts down Axon abilities. It instead reduces their effectiveness by 50%. 

Affected Axons
Repairer: Reduces healing amount to 16 + 0.75%. 
Spectre: Revives with 37.5% HP. 
Cloaker: Duration reduced to 1.5 seconds. 
Infector: Duration reduced to 2 seconds. 
Protector: Damage reduction reduced to 20%. 
Regenerator: Healing reduced to 2 + 0.25%. 
Adv. Reparier: Healing reduced to 50 + 0.75%. 
Replicator: Replicant HP is reduced to 50%. 
Teleporter: Tiles teleported reduced to 3. 
Architect: Duration reduced to 3 seconds. 
Carrier: Hover Jet HP is reduced to 50%. 
Colossus: Takes 50% damage from the front. 
Disruptor: Attack speed reduction reduced to 12.5%. 
Mass Cloaker: Duration reduced to 1.5 seconds. 
Mass Teleporter: Tiles teleported reduced to 1.5. 
Medivac: Reduces healing amount to 22.5 + 0.75%. 
Overcharge Tank: Boost reduced to 160%. 
Reverser: Temporal time reduced to 1.5 seconds. 
Scarab: Nano Scarabs spawn with 50% HP. 
Scarab Lord: Scarabs spawn with 50% HP. 
Linked Squadron: Reduces healing amount to 10 + 0.25%.
Supply Tank: Reduces healing amount to 2.5 + 0.25%. 
Vanguard: Taunt duration reduced to 3.
Unaffected Axons
Berserker
Scout
Sentinel
Nano Scarab
Squadron
Transport
Booster
Hover Jet
Juggernaut
Replicant
Skipper
Avenger Squadron
Adv. Transport
Lifter
Marauder
Purger

Survival
Lowered HP multipliers across the board. 
Added the ability to remove a Defense from your loadout at wave 30. 
Adjusted waves 18 and 19 on Blank Canvas to stand out a little bit less in terms of difficulty. 

Axons
Marauder base HP reduced from 210 to 200. 
Reverser base HP reduced from 160 to 150. 
Reverser ability cooldown increased from 10 to 12s. 

Defenses
Arc Reactor
Global Upgrade no longer increases bounce range. 
U3 damage reduced from 18 to 16. 
U3 bounce damage multiplier reduced from 1.35 to 1.3. 

Artillery
Impact damage increased from 8 to 9. 

Axon Factory
Global Upgrade EMP duration increased from 5 to 6. 

Catapult Mine
Range increased by 1. 

Cryo Beam
Base damage increased from 9 to 10.
U1 damage increased from 5 to 6.  

Drilling Laser
U3 upgrade cost increased from 25 to 30. 
U3 AoE damage increment per second increased from 4 to 4.5. 

Duplicator
Duration increased from 12 to 14s. 
U1 duration increased from 15 to 18s.

Electron Launcher
U2 EMP duration increased from 1 to 2s.  

EMP Gatling
EMP Max duration increased from 4 to 6s. 
EMP duration applied per shot increased from 0.75 to 1.2s. 

EMP Mine
Now deals 20 damage when triggered. 
U2 damage increased from 30 to 40. 

Energy Saw
Base damage increased from 6 to 7. 

Frag Hammer
Base damage increased from 90 to 100. 
U3 damage increased from 45 to 55. 

Inertia Blaster
Base damage increased from 8 to 10. 
Range increased by 0.5. 
U3 Power cost increased from 25 to 30. 
U3 no longer loses damage per shot, it is now per kill.

Link Blaster
Base damage increased from 10 to 12. 
U3 damage increased from 12 to 14.

Network
U3 Credit Cap per wave reduced from 36 to 30. 
U3 Credit Cap increase per U3 Network tower reduced from 6 to 5. 
U3 no longer generates Credits from Squadron units. 
Global Upgrade reworked. Every 2 Network towers in the chain, up to 8, now increases the base damage by 1 and cap by 1. 

Plasmathrower 
U2 and U3 damage increased from 14 to 15. 
Global Upgrade damage bonus against Armor reduced from 250% to 200%. 

Plasma Cannon
U2 EMP duration increased from 5 to 6s.

Plasma Vent
U3 Power cost increased from 25 to 30. 
U3 now has a damage cap of 12 damage per second. 

Reaper
U3 upgrade cost increased from 25 to 30. 
U3 base damage increased from 20 to 24. 
Global Upgrade EMP duration increased from 3 to 4s.

Seeker Drone
U2 stun duration reduced from 2 to 1.5s. 

Target Marker
Maximum damage cap reduced from 2000 to 1500. 

Overloads
Boost Range now increases range by 1, but is active for the entire wave. 
Hypercharge duration increased from 6 to 8s.
EMP Blast Duration increased from 6 to 7s. 
Nuke base damage increased from 60 to 70. 
Radiation Cloud DoT damage increased from 6 to 7.
Zeus Cannon Damage ratio increased from 20% to 25%. 
Zeus Cannon Overload Tech bonus increased from 20% to 25%. 

Techs
Scaling Economics reworked and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- Old: Placing down a Defense reduces the Credit cost of the next Defense of the same type, up to a cap of 6. 
 -- New: When placing down a Defense, reduces the Credit cost of the next Defense of the same type within the same wave by 3. Up to a cap of 12 Costs reset every wave.
Feedback Loop reworked and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- Old: Gain 1 Power for each upgraded Defense, up to a cap of 10 per wave.
 -- New: If you did not sell this wave, gain 3 power for each Defense you upgraded at the end of the wave. Up to a cap of 12.
Cheaper Traps reworked and has been reenabled in Survival:
 -- Old: Reduces the Credit cost of traps by 4. 
 -- New: When placing down a Trap or Mine, each adjacent Trap or Mine of a different type reduces the Credit Cost by 3.
Just a Scratch reworked and has been reenabeld in Survival: 
 -- Old: Axons take 10 damage when they spawn in. 
 -- New: Axons take 10% additional damage within 5 range of the entrance.
Bonus Sell Charges reworked and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- Old: Gain 2 extra Sell Charges each wave. 
 -- New: Gain an extra Sell Charge and 10 Credits when leaking.
Trap Master reworked and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- Old: Reduce Trap and Mine upgrade costs by 5%. 
 -- New: If a Trap or Mine has been active on the field for 5 waves, reduce its Upgrade Costs by 5 Power.
Elite Killers reworked and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- Old: +1 Credits when an upgraded Tower gets a kill, up to a cap of 30 per wave. 
 -- New: If you didn't Sell this wave, each Defense you upgrade gains +10% Damage for the duration of the wave.
Blocker Exchange reworked and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- Old: +1 Blocker when you sell a Tower, Can only trigger once per wave. 
 -- New: When a Blocker is consumed, gain +8 Power. Can only trigger once per wave.
Note: Other Techs that consume Blockers are pre-requisites for this Tech showing up in Survival.
Sentinel reworked and has been reenabled in Survival: 
 -- Old: +2 Credits per unupgraded Tower kill. Up to a cap of 30 per wave. 
 -- New: Every 5th kill from an unupgraded Tower gives +2 Credits, up to a cap of 20 per wave.
Note: This means that any one tower needs to score 5 kills individually to trigger the bonus once. Also, for Network, this doesn't count if ANY of the Network Towers in the chain are upgraded.

[hr][/hr]
Audio
Added a new music track to the game. 
Updated most of the music tracks in the game. 
Added a sound effect for the contextual ping in Multiplayer

Visuals
Each manufacturer now has a unique fade-in animation when built
Improved Start/Exit Portal visuals
Teleport Portals now show up as yellow and have a teleport visual
On Leak visual updated
Updated colorizations on several Defense upgrades, including Pulseray, EMP Gatling, 
Frag Hammer jet trail improved
Link Blaster U2 now has a cable glow to connected Towers

Fixes
Fixed an issue where the Backtrack Overload would end prematurely if cast shortly after a path change took place.
Fixed an issue where the Plasmathrower Global Upgrade wasn't working. 
Fixed an issue where Hypercharge only worked on the first attack on Frag Hammer. 
Fixed an issue where Portable Generator U1 was listing range instead of AoE. 
Fixed an issue in Co-op where some Techs weren't cleared properly and would persist into the next game session when pressing continue.
Fixed an issue where the Sniper Global Upgrade ricochet could bounce to cloaked units. 
Electron Launcher's range can now be buffed past its Global Upgrade cap. 
Fixed an issue where Axons that couldn't be EMP'd triggered EMP Mines.
Fixed an issue where the game could freeze if you had spawners/splitters on maps with a checkpoint or teleporter.
Fixed an issue with the total damage graph.
Fixed a tooltip error in regards to Portable Generator's Credit cost cap.
Fixed an issue where the "Feedback Loop" Tech was granted as soon as it was picked up. 
Fixed an issue where Duplicator clones did not get affected by adjacency buffs. 
Fixed an issue where Scarabs, Replicators, Carriers and Transport units would not get the HP multiplier applied to them after being spawned.
Fixed the Game Over stats overlapping the Multiplayer chat window.  
Fixed an issue where Astrosys' "create a tile under the placed Defense" Tech didn't allow for placing anything else on it after the tower that created it was sold. 
Fixed an issue where the Astrosys Tile Tech allowed you to place tiles outside of the available play area. 
Fixed an issue where some waves on Two Sides only spawned on one side. 
Fixed an issue where the localization string for the Two Sides map in Survival was incorrect after switching language. 
Fixed an issue where Nuclear U3's debuff indication didn't track past portals. 
Fixed the Zeus Cannon Overload Tech not affecting the HP percentage value.
Fixed an issue where the Reverser warning message wouldn't pop up properly. 
Fixed Reverser not listing its "healing" mechanic in its description. 

[hr][/hr]
Soundtrack Released!
Lastly, you can now buy the official soundtrack! It contains 20 tracks, by our composer Nick DeJohn. As noted in our patch notes, every track has received a mastering pass, making the music truly shine. Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3431320/Axon_TD_Uprising_Soundtrack/

[hr][/hr]
That's it for Version 1.1! We hope you enjoy the PvP Mode, as well as the many other additions to the game. If you're looking for strategies and players, you can always join our Discord. Let us know what you think of it!

notes.title: 1.1 Preview - Profile & Skins
notes.content:
We're just under two weeks out from Version 1.1, which contains:
PvP
Profile
Skins
Today, we're giving you a quick preview of the latter two!

[hr][/hr]
Profile
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/56af926687d7e2d42e57b39c0c815294d4cdf992.jpgTurns out the devs lack any stats! We're just ghosts.

Need more stats in your life? Behold, for we have all the stats! Your level is in the top-left corner, which is based on the number of Achievements you've completed.

On the bottom are three tabs. This one is the Game Stats tab. Next to it is your Achievements, which is the same menu as before, just bundled into the Profile. And the last tab is...

Skins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/1888e3e79d580a639cfa9f254835ab8f2e322b36.jpgUnlocking is done per Defense, as opposed to per skin.

Every Defense in the game now has 3 Skins! Don't want all-yellow MegaCorp Defenses? Now mix and match per Defense at will!

For every 2 Achievements you achieve, you get an Unlock Point. Select a Defense, and you'll have all the Skin options for that Defense! There is no pay-to-unlock for Skins.

Here's a couple examples:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/64188ef928aa1edf18f26ee91d56e58e98a88aea.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/7118c9d8e84ea799a2fa135e6ee4ca56c27160df.jpg

Public Alpha
Reminder, you can check out everything in 1.1 early, as soon as right now! We've updated the Alpha a considerable amount in the past weeks, refining PvP Mode, doing final balance tweaks, and more! To try it out:
Right-click Axon TD: Uprising in your game library
Select Properties
Select Betas
From the Beta Participation dropdown menu, select "alpha - Public testing"
You'll then have access to the Version 1.1.alphas!
Let us know what you think of it on our Discord in the #axon-alpha channel.

Release Date
We're almost there! Version 1.1 releases on Friday, January 24th! Look forward to a video overview with our patch notes as well.

notes.title: PvP Alpha & Version 1.1 Release Date
notes.content:
Version 1.1
First up, release date is moving from December to January 24th. However, included in this update will be:
PvP Mode
Player Profile
Skins
These will be unlocked through in-game means, not paid
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/b519c0b146d1a638fecf94ca4acde29c5354335b.jpgIt's got its own banner!

[hr][/hr]
How PvP Works

Loadout
The first thing you'll do in PvP is choose your Loadout. You choose 3 Starting Defenses and 2 Overloads. Note, you can't see what your opponent chooses.
Also, your starting Defenses are Bans. Hypothetically, you and the other player can select the same Defenses, but if you don't, those Defenses will never show up for your opponent throughout the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/af255acae9d2d6ae80f6f462a1450f58dd332a65.jpgThe Lobby looks a little different...

Maps
The mode currently has three map "layouts". That is, each layout has some degree of randomness:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/3d5ee695a05629e4726e1e973c13ee503519855b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/0f6003f1cfea81e8b4286b7d8f75b58897fb486d.jpgProcedurally generated maps? In Axon TD?

Sending Axons
Like Survival, you'll unlock Defenses over time, though it's a bit expedited, as you'll unlock Defense Upgrades at a faster rate. Maze your side, connect to Generators... and Send Axons. It's a new button on your UI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/d83ead54e597fbe14996fb6b499c8d671f2290d6.jpgIt's a tech tree for Axons! Are those Bosses at the end?

How it works is, as you send Axons, two things will happen:
Every two of the same Axon you send will Upgrade it. The cost is raised by 5 Credits, but it gains Armor, or Mk 2, and eventually even Shields.
Send enough of one Axon in a tree, and you'll Unlock the next tier of Axons in that branch.
There's also a default wave order. If you don't send anything, this will spawn. But if you do Send Axons, it'll get mixed into the wave order.


Other Notes
We're still working on improving the UI so it tells you these things, but some things to consider:
End-of-wave Rewards are mostly identical.
The Defense Upgrades may be different, but you and the opponent are given the same New Defense choice, Tech choice, and same distribution of Credits/Adds/Power.
You get Credits back for Axons you send when they're destroyed.
However, you don't get the Credits back when they leak.
Each life you lose gives you a Free Send. These won't progress the Axon Tech Tree, but you can send something back without cost!
Some Defenses cost less in PvP than other modes. This should help make most builds viable!

[hr][/hr]
PvP Alpha
To try out the PvP Mode, follow these steps:
Right-click Axon TD: Uprising in your game library
Select Properties
Select Betas
From the Beta Participation dropdown menu, select "alpha - Public testing"
You'll then have access to the Version 1.1.alphas!
Let us know what you think of it on our Discord in the #axon-alpha channel. We'll be posting up patch notes soon. You'll also be able to find people to play against in there, so hop on in!

[hr][/hr]
That's it for today's preview! As we get closer to Version 1.1's release, expect to see a couple more previews detailing other aspects of the patch. In the meantime, we hope you'll try out the alpha, and let us know what you think of the PvP Mode!

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 - Hotfix

notes.title: Post-Release Content Plans

Just under two weeks ago, we released Version 1.0 of Axon TD: Uprising, and so far, it's been well received! We've seen a good surge of new players and discussions on our forums and our Discord.

We'd like to share with you a sneak peek of what we're working on. Behold:

[hr][/hr]
December Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/6ff9418ce1a0aca6b2aa3f08ab6f6483c0b3fd99.jpg
One of the most requested features we've seen is a PvP Mode where you can send Axons at the opponent, and that's exactly what we're working on!

You'll choose your Loadout just like Survival: a couple of Defenses and your Overloads, and then unlock the rest as you go. Additionally, maps will be procedurally generated.

That's all we can share for now. Look forward to a more in-depth preview of the PvP Mode in November!

[hr][/hr]
Q1 Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/8bbc1051c233abf4301e7ed62d1c0f597d267d31.jpg
We're also working on adding free Skins (no microtransactions) to the game, so you'll be able to customize the looks of your Defenses, as well as a profile with detailed stat tracking. And for those of you that enjoy Survival Co-op, there'll be a new map that really tests your mettle.

[hr][/hr]
And of course, on each of these updates, expect the usual set of QoL, Fixes, and Balance updates, as well as new Quickplay & Co-op Maps.

Thanks to everyone that's played Axon TD: Uprising and for all the feedback! We hope you'll enjoy these future updates.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
At long last, Version 1.0 is here! Every part of the game has received love, from revised maps and missions, to Survival, to Boss Mode, and of course, Chapter 5 is here. You can now play the Campaign out to completion - and in Co-op! Read on for the full patch notes.

[hr][/hr]
General
Added localization for Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Japanese and Korean. 
Added a new Boss, Omega
 -- Spawns 3 beacons every wave in random positions on the unlocked grid that persist through waves. Each one reduces your Defenses' damage until destroyed.  
Added a new Overload, Backtrack. 
 -- Forces the Axons to walk in the opposite direction for 6s. Axons can still cast abilities while under this effect. 
 -- Overload Tech: Increases the duration to 9s. 
Added a new Overload, Radiation Cloud.
 -- Deploys a radioactive cloud in a 5x5 area around one of your Defenses for 10 seconds. Axons within the area take damage and all healing received is instead taken as damage.
 -- Overload Tech: Radiation cloud duration increased to 15 seconds.
Added 11 new achievements.
 -- Clear Chapter 5 of the Campaign
 -- Complete all optional objectives in the campaign. 
 -- Clear the fifth Boss in the Campaign on Hard.
 -- Clear the sixth Boss in the Campaign on Hard.
 -- Clear Survival "Two Sides" on Normal
 -- Clear Survival "Two Sides" on Hard
 -- Complete a map with Boss Mode enabled. 
 -- Complete any Quickplay or Co-op map on Hard difficulty with Chaos, Rush Mode and Boss Mode enabled. 
 -- Unlock 8 Global Defense Upgrades in one game. 
 -- Complete all Co-op maps.
 -- Unlock all 40 Global Defense Upgrades at least once at any point.
Improvements have been made to super ultra wide screen support. 
Added the ability to disable Replay creation and Leaderboard submission. This does not work in Co-op. 
There's now a button for switching player perspective in Co-op replays. 
Your difficulty selection is now saved between sessions. 
Checkpoints no longer disappear for minor version updates. 
You now get a warning when a Boss is about to spawn, both as pop-up on the side of your screen and an icon above the spawn it's coming from. They're also part of the wave preview. 
Added a warning pop-up for Carriers. 
The game now displays the name of the current map/mission you're playing and the current difficulty when you pause. 
Tower selection UI has been adjusted a little so that the Global Upgrade button is no longer outside of it. 
Defenses now display a buff percentage on their damage increases. 
Your Defenses now have a kill counter.
You can now see the Axons' stats when selected.
The Codex has been updated with a new look. 
Adjusted the UI in various menus to make it more consistent and user-friendly.
Adjusted the minimap zoom a little bit. 
Updated the in-game Credits to include more of our wonderful contributors. 
Map Editor: Your level will now be autosaved in a separate file every 15 minutes. 
Map Editor: Added the ability to place Blockers. 

[hr][/hr]
Campaign
Chapter 5 has been added. Play out the epic conclusion to the story on Mega-451 with Patricia and Omni!
The Campaign can now be played in Co-op. 
The entire Campaign has been updated to provide more of a challenge in the current balance sandbox, including changes to wave compositions, level layouts, the Tech Tree and the end of wave rewards. 
All the cutscenes have been updated with voice acting, SFX and music. 
You can now resume a Campaign mission from Checkpoints that are saved every wave.

Added optional objectives to Chapter 4.

Survival

The Upgrade Menu has been renamed to "Meta Techs" and has been reorganized horizontally. 
Added 8 new Meta Techs:
 -- Path Manipulation: Every 10 waves, you get an extra end of wave choice, allowing you to choose between 4 ADDs, 2 Recycles, or 2 ADDs and 2 Blockers. 
 -- Resource Conversion: Every 10 waves, gain the ability to exchange your Credits and Power. Power has twice the value of Credits. Your current highest resource according to this ratio gets converted to the other.

notes.title: 1.0 Preview - Co-op Campaign
notes.content:
We're 4 Weeks away from the Version 1.0 Official Release of Axon TD: Uprising, and today, we're showing off the Co-op Campaign feature!

[hr][/hr]
How it Works

By default, when playing the Campaign, it's Singleplayer. However, you can switch it to Co-op quite easily:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/522c014c3f707ad3c2bfc32787020b15270cdae9.jpg

And when you host a session, it looks quite familiar:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/a970c70a4383856d8e2e2453ec237cdee7f41fe9.jpg

You've got your "Make Public" button, and the ability to invite directly. Now,, if you wanted to join a public session yourself:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/337f23ce5cba24c1f243fe72a362f53051261912.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/21455bd6e14127c0874b9196561f32d78e90f079.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/24d1745bc0a449198f7ae66101bbe6ac2a1cdf01.jpg

And now the two of you can play together! As for how the splitting of things works:
Host chooses the mission.
 -- It is possible for the host to play a mission the other player does not have access to in their own progress.
You each use your own Tech Tree & Loadout.
You each run your own pace for Dialogue & Cutscenes.
In-game, Resources & Rewards are split between each player.

[hr][/hr]
1.0 Alpha

You can even try it out right now in the 1.0 Alpha! To access the alpha:
Right-click Axon TD: Uprising in your game library
Select Properties
Select Betas
From the Beta Participation dropdown menu, select "alpha - Public testing"

We're currently on Version 1.0.alpha5. Some of those experimental Survival changes we mentioned last time have been rolled back. You can read the alpha patch notes on our Discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/e24a85ab0f6b9fb35002bd2d9f509c6ef9e7bd24.jpg

[hr][/hr]
That's it for this time! For our next preview, we'll show off a sneak peak of Chapter 5 as well as the new Boss Mode in Quickplay!

notes.title: Version 0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The next version is here! Version 0.6 includes New Defenses & Axons, reconnect support for Co-op, new Co-op maps, more Qol, a bunch of balance updates, fixes, and more. Check out the 0.6 Overview for the fancy nutshell; full notes are below!

[previewyoutube=vbNqbiN-oaI;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
New Defenses

New MegaCorp Tower: Discharge Blaster
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/2a076e60163921b2cffc7d1295d44f09bf5fa871.jpg
Uses a battery to overcharge its attacks. Starts at a low cooldown, but the cooldown increases by 0.05 for every attack, until it hits the upper cap. 
After 3 seconds of not attacking, the cooldown is reduced by 0.1 per second, until it hits the attack speed cap.

Stats:
Cost: 100
Range: 2
Damage: 18
AoE: 1.5
Attack speed: 2.5 to 0.42
Upgrades:
Upgrade 1: Stuns all Axons hit for .25 seconds. 
Upgrade 2: While it is attacking and has battery charge left, increase adjacent Towers’ attack speed by 15%. 
Upgrade 3: Damage is doubled, no longer has an AoE. Now prioritizes support units. 
Global Upgrade: The battery recharges twice as fast.


New Vex Industries Tower: Axon Factory
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/57d80d5ac67ab7c7592095f8b3834f5ec3940c4e.jpg
Spawns a radioactive Replicant that paths from the placement location to the nearest spawn point. Explodes upon collision with an Axon and leaves a pool of radioactive waste on the ground dealing damage per second through Armor & Shields. Pool lasts for 4 seconds. 
Spawned units have a lifespan of 10 seconds, then they self-detonate.

Stats:
Cost: 100
Range: N/A
Damage: 125 + 8 area damage per second
AoE: 1.5 + 1
Cooldown: 15
Upgrades:
Upgrade 1: Instead spawns 2 Boosters over 3 seconds before it goes on cooldown. 
Upgrade 2: Radioactive pool lasts longer but deals less damage, and applies a 20% Damage Amp on passing Axons for 3 seconds. 
Upgrade 3: Spawns in a phased out Booster that passes through Axons until it expires, slowing them by 20% for 2 seconds. 
Global Upgrade: Every 15 seconds, EMP an Axon adjacent to the factory for 4 seconds.


New Astrosys Labs Tower: Duplicator
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/f900049cbfb83d8442d5f590f151f1e2da4db16d.jpg
Transforms into a Tower that can deal damage, dealing 160% of the original tower’s damage.
Once a Tower has been copied, it cannot be copied again for 60 seconds. Transformation lasts 12 seconds.

Stats:
Cost: 100
Range: 5x5
Damage: N/A
AoE: N/A
Cooldown: 20
Upgrades:
Upgrade 1: Transformation lasts 3 seconds longer.
Upgrade 2: Increases range of the transformed Tower by 0.5. Does not work with area towers.
Upgrade 3: Transformed Towers costing 75 Credits or less instead deal 225% damage. 
Global Upgrade: Casting an Overload on a Duplicator Tower casts the same Overload again on the same Tower 10 seconds later for free.


New New Frontier Mine: Catapult Mine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/fbd827d333137d4bc766e30f37b78591055ec1f2.jpg
Directional Mine. Throws an Axon on the mine 3 tiles in the aimed direction. If it collides with a tower, the Axons are stunned for 0.5 seconds. If they’re thrown towards an empty tile and have less than 10% HP, they fall off the map and are destroyed. Otherwise Axons are slowed by 40% for 3 seconds after landing. 
Cannot throw Colossus, Juggernaut, Vanguard, Marauder or Architect.

Stats:
Cost: 75
Range: 3
Damage: N/A
AoE: N/A
Cooldown: 20
Upgrades:
Upgrade 1: Increases throwing distance by 1. 
Upgrade 2: Deals 40 damage in a 1.5 AoE around where the thrown Axon lands. 
Upgrade 3: Temporarily removes Armor and Shields from thrown Axons. Duration of 10 seconds. 
Global Upgrade: Mini-stuns Axons passing under a thrown Axon for 0.2 seconds.

[hr][/hr]
New Axons

New Axon: Skipper
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/5f354beb875edc6541327313cccfc9fe67f7acbf.jpg
Ignores Mines and Traps.
HP: 100
Move speed: 1.2

New Axon: Reverser
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/35e94506be74bb0d59772941f29b817883dc626a.jpg
Starts at the exit and leaks at the entrance. Every 10 seconds, it phases forward, healing all the damage it has taken in the last 3 seconds. If it passes any other Axon, that Axon gets a 100% speed boost for 3 seconds. 
HP: 170
Move speed: 1.8

New Axon: Architect
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/156d12e1d8f1437e5caba5c7034c51fb34f906ed.jpg
Every 15 tiles traveled, the Architect stops where it's at and adds a new temporary tile to the grid for 8 seconds. 
HP: 250
Move speed: 1.2

New Axon: Marauder
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/9984b7b185fec5cda0e3e6d8155f370c306f486c.jpg
Every 10 seconds, the Marauder goes debuff immune for 4 seconds and gets a 100% move speed boost. 
HP: 240
Move speed: 1.2

New Axon Boss: Creator
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/e8e635d252a525072d6666766c607188d416c918.jpg
Every 10 seconds, it spawns 6 Axons depending on its current stage. 
Stage 1: Berserker Mk II
Stage 2: Booster Mk II
Stage 3: Replicator Mk II
Stage 4: Armored Infector Mk II
Stage 5: Shielded Teleporters Mk II
Stage 6: Marauder Mk II

[hr][/hr]
General
Axon TD now supports Steam Rich Presence, displaying your in-game Status in the Steam community. 
Drag-selecting Defenses no longer include Defenses that are unable to target. 
You can now set a targeting priority while having multiple Defenses selected. 
Added the ability to select all Defenses that can target by pressing 'H'.  
Added a Contextual Warning message for when you first encounter Architects and Hover Jets/Carriers. This is to warn newer players about their abilities. 
Adjusted Tutorial mission 3 to include a mention of Recycles and their new functionality of being able to remove Obstacles. 
Adjusted attacking towers to say "attack speed" instead of cooldown. 
In Campaign, you can now rewatch unlocked cutscenes in your Journal. 
EMP is now indicated by a magenta-colored bar on top of the HP bar. 
Axons that are debuff immune now have a distorted HP bar indicator.

Co-op
A new Co-op Survival Map has been added called Big Platforms, based on the Platform map from singleplayer Survival, but without checkpoints.
New 2-player map: Across. 
New 3-player map: Freehold. 
New 4-player map: Roundabout. 
Co-op solo is now played offline. 
Co-op sessions can now be restarted from in-game after passing a vote. 
You can now resume a Co-op game from a checkpoint as long as you don't lose from the Co-op menu.
You can no longer pick up more than one Tower, Upgrade or Tech in one wave in solo Co-op.

Survival
Added 6 new end waves to the wave 30+ list featuring the new Axons. 
Blank Canvas
 -- Reduced the HP multiplier for waves 30+.
 -- Slightly increased the HP multiplier for waves 80+. 
Platform
 -- Reduced the 30+ waves HP scaling. 
 -- Reduced the amount of tiles on the map. 
Each Survival map now has a rotation of 3 Bosses after wave 30 instead of being random. However, the wave 120 Boss will always be either the Goliath or Creator. 
Blank Canvas
 – Revenant → Guardian → Iron Centipede → repeat | Final Boss is Goliath. 
Islands
 – Guardian → Iron Centipede → Goliath → repeat | Final Boss is Creator.
Platform
 – Creator → Revenant → Goliath → repeat | Final Boss is Goliath.
Divider
 – Goliath → Revenant → Creator → repeat | Final Boss is Goliath. 
Big Platform
 – Revenant → Guardian → Iron Centipede → repeat | Final Boss is Creator. 
Added descriptions to the Survival maps in the Survival and Lobby menus. 

Map Editor
Added a tutorial video for the Map Editor. 
Added tooltips to most of the value boxes. 
Added the ability to press Tab to cycle through value boxes. 
Made various UI adjustments, most notably in the Axon and Tech selection screens. 
You can now simulate the player count when testing your map. 

Visuals
New death visual
Updated Reaper Tower attack visuals
Updated Seeker Drone Tower attack visuals
Updated Orbital Cannon Tower attack visuals
Updated Plasma Cannon U2 & U3 attack visuals
Added a Debuff Immunity visual for Purger & Lifter
Various tweaks to backgrounds

Fixes
Fixed Bosses giving almost no additional score. 
Fixed an issue where Command Link wasn't buffing the range of Electron Launcher. 
Fixed a visual issue where the Command Link "link" would remain after selling a Tower connected to it. 
Fixed an issue where Mass Driver was hitting twice on every shot. 
Fixed an issue where the Temporal Mine Global Upgrade was triggering multiple times per activation. 
Fixed an issue where Siphon Cannons couldn't target Axons with Seeker Drones attached to them. 
Fixed an issue where the Colossus frontal shield was blocking multiple effects that it wasn't supposed to be blocking.
Fixed an issue with Hover Jet pathing. 
Fixed an issue where the "Place a Tower on a Blocker to gain Credits" Tech was causing your Blocker count to go negative.
Fixed an issue where the UI cost display didn't update on wave reset with the Mega Expansionist Survival Upgrade. 
Fixed an issue causing you to stay connected to Co-op lobbies you had left. 
Fixed an issue in Survival where you could get stuck with only 7 Defenses in your loadout. 
Fixed some Techs accidentally being removed from the Survival Tech pool. 
Fixed Blockers having a target priority setting. 
Fixed an issue where some parts of the descriptions got cut off in the tooltips.
Fixed an issue where the UI got cut off at higher resolutions.
Fixed being able to click a spawn point through UI elements. 
Fixed various issues with Co-op lobbies. 
Fixed various tooltip errors.

[hr][/hr]
Balance
Added Architect and Lifter to the Smart Targeting support priority list. 
Smart targeting has been updated for single-target towers to more reliably target down high priority support units. 
Defenses on Default targeting will now prioritize Bosses that are close to leaking. 
Drilling Laser now also prioritizes support units. 

Axons
Carrier base HP reduced from 160 to 150. 
Lifter adjusted: 
 -- Now Lifts an Axon for 10 seconds then drops it. Cooldown of 3 seconds. 
 -- Lifters can no longer Lift Medivacs. 
Mass Teleporter:
 -- Now has a max cap of 15 Axons it can teleport at once. 
 -- Cooldown increased from 10s to 12s. 
 
Defenses

Artillery
U3 adjusted
 -- Power cost increased from 25 to 30. 
 -- Damage reduced from 15 to 13. 
 -- Cooldown reduced from 2 to 1.5. 

Blast Cannon
U2 Power cost increased from 25 to 30, and slow reduced from 40% to 35%. 

Cryo Beam
Slow per stack reduced from 20% to 15%. 

Drilling Laser
Range increased from 2.5 to 3. 

Electron Launcher
Damage increased by 1 for the base tower and all upgrades. 

Energy Saw
Base damage increased from 5 to 6.

Frag Hammer
U3 damage reduced from 65 to 50. 
Stun duration reduced from .8s to .7s at base, U3 from .4s to .3s.

Gravity Trap
Passive slow now automatically applies to all upgrades.
Passive slow reduced from 25% to 20%. 
U1 stun reduced from 2.5s to 2s. 
Global Upgrade replaced: 
 -- Old: Increases passive slow rate to 30% and the passive slow applies to all upgrades. 
 -- New: Increases passive slow rate to 25% and slow linger duration to 2 seconds.

Mass Driver
Base damage increased from 60 to 65.

Missile Launcher
Base damage increased from 18 to 22. 
U1 damage increased from 13 to 16.
U2 stun duration increased from .5s to .7s. 

Nuclear
Repair debuff increased from 35% to 50%. 
Base damage increased from 5 to 6. 
U1 cap increased from 12 to 15. 
U3 Power cost increased from 35 to 40. 
U3 damage increased from 50 over 10s to 64 over 8s. 

Orbital Cannon
U2 damage increased from 36 to 38. 

Plasmathrower
Now resets its remaining salvo count when not firing continuously.

Plasma Cannon
U2 EMP duration increased from 4s to 6s. 
U3 Amp increased from 25% to 30%. 

Portable Generator
Base cost reduced from 40 to 30. 
Credit cost now increases by 2 for each Portable Generator you build, with a cap of 50. 
U2 Power Cost increased from 30 to 35. 
Global Upgrade damage bonus reduced from 25% to 20%. 

Radiation Vent
Global Upgrade amp per debuff type increased from 3% to 4%. 

Siphon Cannon
Global Upgrade replaced: 
 -- Old: Increases the range of the Siphon Field by 0.5. 
 -- New: Increases the damage of adjacent Defenses by 15% for 4s when firing. 

Temporal Mine
Credit cost increased from 50 to 75. 
Upgrade costs increased from 25 to 30 for all upgrades. 
Global Upgrade damage increased from 75 to 90. 

[hr][/hr]
Overloads
Compound Rounds has been reworked: 
 -- Is now called Shredder. 
 -- Removes Armor and Shields from Axons in an AoE of 3 around it for 10 seconds. 
 -- The Shredder Overload Tech increases the duration of this debuff by 5 seconds. 
Nuke damage reduced from 50 + 10% to 75 + 6%. 
Amplify base Amp reduced from 50% to 40%. 

Techs
Power On Leak Power bonus increased from 10 to 15 in Quickplay and Co-op. 
Wave End ADD now has a minimum wave of 10 and gives an ADD every 3 waves instead of every 2 in Survival. 
 -- Getting this one early pretty much ensured you were good with ADDs for the rest of the game.
+1 ADDs if you don't pick an ADD from the end of wave reward now has a minimum wave of 20. 
 -- Combined with the Tech above, this resulted in an insane abundance of ADDs.
Interest per wave reduced from 15% to 10% in Survival. 
 -- Another source of free income that was too easy to just get every wave and fed into itself.
Global Credit Cost reduction reduced from 10% to 8% in Survival. 
Global Power Cost reduction reduced from 10% to 8% in Survival.
 -- These techs stack up too much in late game Survival.
The Nuke Overload Tech has been adjusted to instead give +1 AoE. 
 -- The high HP damage in an AoE scaled disproportionally well in late game Survival.
The Amplify Overload Tech Amp bonus reduced from 25% to 20%. 
 -- This has a very high value in late game Survival.
+5% Damage for all Defenses for the next 5 waves now has a minimum wave of 10 in Survival.
Deployment Aura no longer deactivates from selling. 
Big Spender reworked: 
 -- Old: +1 ADD when spending 100 Credits or more in one wave. Can only trigger once per wave. 
 -- New: +1 ADD at the start of the wave when spending 150 Credits or more without selling.
Lone Tower replaced: 
 -- Old: +1 ADD when placing a Tower with no adjacent Defenses. Selling deactivates this Tech for the duration of the wave.
 -- New: Renamed to Hard Materials: +1 ADD when Recycling an Obstacle. 
Sweeper reworked: 
 -- Old: +1 Recycle when placing a Defense within 3 range of the exit. Selling deactivates this Tech for the duration of the wave. 
 -- New: +1 Recycle if you place down a damage dealing Tower within 3 range of the exit during the wave.
Buy Low, Sell High reworked: 
 -- Old: +10 Credits when selling a Defense costing 50 Credits or less. 
 -- New: +30 Credits when selling 3 or more Defenses in one wave.
Power Build reworked: 
 -- Old: +3 Power per adjacent empty tile when placing down your first Defense in a wave. 
 -- New: -8 Upgrade cost for the first Defense you build this wave. Selling deactivates this Tech for the duration of this wave.

Survival Upgrades
"Mega Kill" reworked: 
 -- Now gives a constant 10% damage bonus to all MegaCorp Defenses that cost 50 Credits or less. 

[hr][/hr]
As usual, with a major update that adjusts balance, Leaderboards have been wiped. Experiment at will with the new Defenses, and look forward to more updates as we near our Official Release!

notes.title: Version 0.5.3 - Map Editor Update
notes.content:
With Version 0.5, we added a Map Editor to the game, along with Steam Workshop support. Today's update, in addition to hotfixes, adds some new features and QoL to the editor.

General
Co-op Leaderboard submissions will now show the end wave. This is not retroactive. 

Map Editor
Hovering over a custom map now shows a little preview window. 
In any box with a number value, you can now scroll your mousewheel to adjust the value while hovering over the box. 
Added a consolidated Menu for adjusting the grid and level called "Configure Grid", where you can adjust the positioning of your entire level in addition to adjusting the Grid Size. 
Added the ability to "Unlock" tiles, allowing you to place tiles where you can build without the player expanding to them. 
Added the ability to place down upgraded pre-placed Defenses. 
Added the ability to rotate directional towers before placing them down. 
Added the ability to use one of our backgrounds for your level under the "Game Settings" Menu. 
You can now see the HP and move speed of all the Axons in the Axon selection screen. 
You can now see the HP of any given wave, per path and in total. 
Added the ability copy and paste the end of wave rewards. 
There's now a standard template that creates 3 end of wave reward options using our standardized values from Quickplay and Co-op maps. This means 60 Credits = 3 ADDs = 30 Power. 
Added the ability to select "Random Tech" and select up to 30 Techs to be included in the randomization as an end of wave reward. Acquired Techs won't show up in the next wave even if you reuse the same list. 
Added the ability to spawn Bosses. 

Fixes
Fixed an issue where you could prematurely access the first mission in chapter 5, only to be permanently stuck in a loading screen. 
Fixed an issue where you could load checkpoints in Solo Co-op, resulting in a permanent loading screen. 
Fixed an issue where the "You Know Nothing" achievement was triggering prematurely. 
Fixed an issue where Siphon Cannon couldn't target a unit that had been Lifted. 
Fixed an exploit in Survival. 
Fixed an issue with replays related to the random seed. 
Fixed an issue where the distance to the Destination for Axons wasn't calculated correctly after being lifted by Lifter. 
Fixed some audio issues related to ambience and attenuation.

notes.title: April Fool's 0.4.666 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Guess what! Version 0.4 had so many bugs, we found even more wrong with the game. So this hotfix here should address the remainder of the problems. We also adjusted balance just slightly. Read on below for the full notes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/4a54b8102fcdf7059a427a9abfe2c477991ca4aa.gif
Missile Launcher wasn't firing enough missiles, so we fixed that.

[hr][/hr]
General
Due to lack of use, the Builder has been removed from the game.
Every time a Defense kills an Axon, confetti explodes from it. Time to celebrate!
Placing an Add will require you solve a quick math problem in limited time. Failure to answer in time or getting it wrong will result in Subtracting a random tile in your maze.
Revolutionary Discord Integration added. Every single message from the Element Studios server will now appear in the middle of the screen, in every mode. If the server is unable to reach your account because you're offline, your account will receive a VAC ban.
In Co-op, you can no longer send resources to each other. In this feature's place, you have the ability to send Axons to your partners.
In the Campaign, OMEGA has been updated to be a washing machine stuck in the spin circle for all eternity.
Western Mode from Element TD 2 has been added. There is no option to turn it off.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/f2efd0acdb25ed162629729159ebdc246ca3d42c.gif
Pulseray now perma-stuns Axons. Finally, this tower is useful!

[hr][/hr]
Axons

New Axon: Adaptive
Becomes resistant to your highest damaging Element Damage Type from the previous wave.
Advanced Repairer
On death, repairs the platform itself to its original state, restoring all Recycled Tiles. These are truly advanced tactics!
Avenger Squadron
These are far too expensive to hire and have thus been replaced with bootleg versions: Adventure Squadrons.
Berserker
Each time a fellow Berserker on the field dies, it rages and attacks your Defenses.
Booster
No longer speeds itself up. Attaches to your Defenses, speeding them up by a factor of 10. Any Defense that refuses to move will have its legs ripped from the platform in dramatic slow motion.
Carry
Renamed from Carrier to Carry.
If supported properly, it will lead accrue enough gold to max out its items and lead the Axons to victory.
Cleaner
Renamed from Purger to Cleaner.
Now cleans up all the messes your Defenses and the other Axons made. Great for the environment!
Cloaker
Has been updated to wear an actual cloak. Now it looks 200% cooler!
Colossus
Has a shadow that can be considered climbable. Do you have the skills?
Disruptor
Disrupts your game's input by adding real-time lag from around the world. Experience up to twelve-hour long delays per action, and really feel like you're traveling the world, one delay at a time!
Engarde!
Renamed from Vanguard to Engarde!
Periodically surrounding Defenses to a duel. If it is not destroyed by the end of the duration, it shouts "Engarde!" and stabs the challenged Defenses with a fencing blade, permanently disabling them.
Hoverjet
Now jetpacks over your entire maze to the end. There will be no stopping them.
Infector
Its ability to shut down nearby Defenses has been adjusted to be contagious.
Juggernaut
Now quotes its iconic line when it spawns and when it dies.
Lifter
Now races to the finish against other Axons. Winners proceed to the next race. Losers are yeeted into space.
Linked Squadron
They are now joined at the hip. As a courtesy, please congratulate them before you destroy them.
Mass Cloaker
Goes out of its way to equip all other Axons in range with cloaks, making them 200% cooler. What a nice bot!
Mass Teleporter
See the presentation below.
Overcharge Tank
Now has an actual cannon. Periodically shoots your Defenses with overcharged projectiles, knocking them back by several tiles.
Overprotector
Renamed from Protector to Overprotector.
Gets overprotective about its fellow Axons. Any attempt to intrude further on this will be met with tirades of justice.
Regenerator
No longer has an HP cap. Now regenerates 5% of its Current Max HP per second.
Repairer
Now helps repair your Defenses. Consider keeping one as a pet.
Replicator
Has been upgraded to be capable of manufacturing Tea, Earl Grey, Hot.
Replican't
Renamed from Replicant to Replican't.
It just can't do it anymore, man. It's too much for the poor bot.
Rogue Squadron
Renamed from Squadron to Rogue Squadron.
Does exactly what you think it does. It goes rogue, and it doesn't come back, not even for a modern remaster.
Scarab Lord
No longer has a limit to how many times it can split. Should it eventually shrink small enough to split the atom, it will trigger an atomic detonation.
Scout
Has been given a shotgun, a baseball bat, and can double jump.
Sentinel
No longer takes damage from any source. Not even insults.
Spectre
Now haunts your Defenses after dying by inflicting a permanent Guilt Trip debuff. Defenses that shut down as a result of this should seek therapy.
Speedy Supply Tank
First!
Supply Tank
Now supplies affected Axons with tanks. Lots of them. Tanks will periodically shoot back at your Defenses.
Transport
You can now hire them as shipping services! However, do be aware - they tend to carry maniacal Squadron-type Axons in the back that get rather obsessive over shipped goods.
Teleporter
Has been installed into all standard transportation facilities. Just don't get your atoms mixed with a crate!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/7db09b7c0b72912ed19f7b36404fed59f27b7a91.gif
Mass Teleporter felt very underwhelming and rarely was a threat. Its AoE and jump distance has been adjusted to compensate.

[hr][/hr]
Towers

New Tower: An Actual Tree
The game lacked a distinct amount of nature. Now you can plant trees one tower at a time!
Arc Reactor Tower
Now does exactly what it says. What will happen in the next story arc? Gives you play-by-play reactions of every scene, character, and implied moral quandary.
Blast Cannon Tower
Launches itself into space when it fires. This tower is blasting off again!
Bonk Hammer Tower
Renamed from Frag Hammer to Bonk Hammer.
Now makes a "bonk!" sound when it hits Axons, striking them into the ground. They'll need a shovel to get out!
Carolina Reaper Tower
Renamed from Reaper to Carolina Reaper Tower.
Now fires hot sauce beams that scale to millions of scoville units.
Command Link Tower
Towers adjacent to this are now obligated to command the troops. Effective leadership, huh?
Cryobeam & Drilling Laser Towers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/a89525af95d54932367d060572152916e0d751a5.jpg
If you know, you know.
Electron Launcher Tower
Its energy orb now has the properties of an actual Electron. You will never know both its velocity and position.
EMP Gatling Tower
Now fires at a rate of ten thousand rounds per minute. In exchange, it costs four hundred thousand credits to fire this weapon for twelve seconds.
EMP Mine
Now accurately depicts the properties of EMP. When triggered, it permanently shuts down itself and all other Axons and Defenses within range.
Gravity Driver Tower
Renamed from Adam Driver to Gravity Driver.
He needs more power. More! MORE!!!
Gravity Generator Tower
Now turns Axons upside-down. What a cruel joke.
Gravity Trap
No longer slows Axons. Instead, it presents the gravity of the situation in as detailed as a manner as possible. You'll be stuck here all day.
Hide & Seek Drone Tower
Renamed from Seeker Drone to Hide & Seek Drone.
It's already hidden. What do you mean you haven't found it yet?
Inertia Blaster Tower
With each attack, it gains inertia. Should it gain enough inertia, it will exceed the galactic speed limit and transcend reality.
Link Blaster Tower
This defense now does exactly what it says. Upon firing, it destroys a random link from the internet. Sometimes, this hits random fairy boys in green. How does that happen?
Mass Driver Tower
Added recoil. With each shot, it will launch itself backwards by 1 Tile. Should it fall off the map and die, its blood will forever stain your hands. That's on you, man.
Missile Launcher Tower
Were you not paying attention? See the presentation posted at the top.
Nanite Nest Trap
Periodically spawns penguins. They might attach to Axons. Or they might be your front door. Have you checked lately?
Network Tower
Now has Global Range and has made a profile on LinkedIn. It's making new connections faster than ever!
Nuclear Tower
Upon building, effectively nukes everything within a 150 km radius. Look at the bright side, you solved the Axon conflict!
Orbital Cannon Tower
Calls in a true orbital strike from... wait. That's no moon. That's a-
Plasma Cannon Tower
Its plasma properties are now more accurately represented. Upon firing, a hot flash of doom encapsulates everything in the immediate area and vaporizing it all down. This includes Axons, Defenses, the Tiles, and even your mouse cursor.
Plasmathrower Tower
Fixed a bug that prevented this tower from throwing the game. Now comes with a 100% lose rate, guaranteed.
Plasma Seesaw Tower
Renamed from Plasma Saw to Plasma Seesaw.
It now loads Axons into either side, allowing them to play with one another in a safe and sound environment. Well, asides from the plasma sawblades. Be careful with your fingers!
Portable Generator Tower
Now casts its own Overloads at indiscriminate times. Should you be out of Power, it will use any Power source necessary. It's 11PM at night. Is your computer safe?
Proximity Mine
This defense has been diagnosed with anxiety problems and has been removed from the game. Now it's taking a step towards a better- *beep beep*
Pulseray Tower
See the presentation listed somewhere up above.
Radiation Vent Trap
Has been given more ventilation so it can breathe better. Now breathe in clean radioactive air! Wait-
Siphon Cannon Tower
Now siphons damage off your other Defenses, including other Siphon Cannons, and even itself. Upon firing, if its net damage exceeds 100,000, it will create a black hole that enraptures the entire map and game. This is the only way to get the "I beat the game" Achievement.
Sniper Tower
It's retired from professional hunting. Now snipes amazing deals off the internet for you. What a steal!
Target Marker Mine
This defense now does exactly what it says. It will target a marker for you. However, it's up to you to write anything with it. It's not doing the work for you.
Temporal Mine
It sends Axons so far back in time, they end up in a different game. Say, isn't there a patch coming for Element TD 2 in a few months?
Vent Trap
Renamed from Plasma Vent to Vent Trap.
No longer shoots plasma flames. Will now vent at oncoming Axons. Sometimes about its day; other times, it just can't stop yelling. Please be there for your Vent Traps. They just need someone to listen to them.
Waste Thrower Tower
Renamed from Artillery to Waste Thrower Tower.
Launches radioactive waste onto the map itself. Why are you littering so badly?
World Engine Tower
See the presentation listed below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/e74043e1f4aa3f2e3043d8efd93046bbf5cb2fcf.gif
For something called World Engine, it didn't really affect the world that much. This is now fixed.

[hr][/hr]
If you haven't picked up on it by now, this patch isn't real. We wish it was, but sadly, implementing some of these features could breach international law. We can't tell you which ones, so you'll have to speculate.

However, we do invite you to make your own adjustments. Post below what you'd like to see in Axoff TD: Downrising!

notes.title: State of the Roadmap
notes.content:
Greetings, folks! This is just a little progress update, tellin' ya where we're at, and what's left on our Roadmap.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877500/c4b90073f42d914525f316373e59db88ad30afae.png

Earlier this month, we released Version 0.4, our largest update yet. New Defenses, new Axons, Survival Co-op, a massive Campaign update, and more. Basically, everything listed in Q1 2024 above.

As for our next update, unless we split it in half, it should contain everything listed in Q2 2024 above, and more! We're also working on more Tutorials, more Music, more Achievements, and balance as per usual. Speaking of which...

[hr][/hr]
Update on Balance Updates
With our latest additions to the Defense Roster, even after multiple hotfixes, it would appear some our new Defenses still need some tuning. So of course, we're working to address that. Other points include reducing spammability of certain Defenses, and... counters against Shields.

Of every mechanic in the game, Shields is the hardest counter. You either have stuff that can remove it easily... or half your defense gets negated and you die. We're looking into adjusting this so it's still something you have to look out for and plan around, just not to as insane a degree.

Beyond that, we're adjusting a bunch of Techs to be less abusable (ie, conditionals that are too easy to proc), and buffing ones that are hard to use.

[hr][/hr]
In a nutshell, we're still on track to hit our Roadmap goals. Next week or so, we'll finally show off a long awaited teaser of our map editor, so look forward to that!
